newsitem.title: USA: Olsten target of shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: Olsten target of shareholder suit.

text.p: Two law firms said Thursday they have filed a lawsuit in New York on behalf all persons who bought common stock of Olsten Corp between May 31, 1996 and November 21, 1996, including those who bought the stock in connection with a merger with Quantum Health Resources Inc.

The complaint alleges that Olsten and certain of its officers and directors, misrepresented and failed to disclose that the company's agreement with CIGNA Healthcare to provide home-healthcare to CIGNA's members was unprofitable at its inception and during its performance, artificially inflating the price of Olsten stock, which was sold by insiders for profits in excess of $10 million.
The case is being represented by the law firms of Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP and Schiffrin & Craig Ltd, among others.
Representatives from Olsten were not immediately available for comment.
